nodes.label: painting1.jpg
nodes.description: Impressionist oil painting of rural French farmhouses: dirt lane through wooden gates toward two stone cottages with tiled roofs, green hedges, flanking trees, and cloudy blue sky.

nodes.label: Main stone cottage
nodes.description: Larger two-story stone farmhouse left-center; pale ochre walls, brown tile roof, chimney, green shutters, dark doorways; central subject of the scene.

nodes.label: Side stone cottage
nodes.description: Smaller adjoining stone house to the right; peaked tile roof, chimney with finial, few small windows; secondary dwelling attached to main cottage cluster.

nodes.label: Dirt lane
nodes.description: Rutted sandy path from foreground center leading between gate posts toward cottage entrances; light ochre and beige brushwork.

nodes.label: Left wooden gate
nodes.description: Rustic timber five-bar gate and post on left foreground; open or ajar, framing path entry.

nodes.label: Right fence post
nodes.description: Vertical wooden post and rail fragment on right foreground; pairs with left gate to form path gateway.

nodes.label: Garden hedges
nodes.description: Dense green shrubbery and hedges along path and in front of cottages; mid-ground vegetation mass.

nodes.label: Left tall tree
nodes.description: Tall slender deciduous tree left of main cottage; green canopy against sky, trunk rising from lower left.

nodes.label: Right canopy tree
nodes.description: Full leafy tree right of side cottage; frames right edge of composition.

nodes.label: Cloudy sky
nodes.description: Pale blue sky with broken white and cream cumulus clouds; impressionist broken-color brushwork filling upper half.

nodes.label: Brown tile roofs
nodes.description: Warm brown/ochre pitched roofs on both cottages; textured tile strokes with chimney stacks.

nodes.label: Impressionist rural landscape
nodes.description: Genre/style: late-19th-c impressionist farmyard scene—loose brushwork, natural light, rural domestic architecture, no sharp outlines.

nodes.label: French farmhouse motif
nodes.description: Subject motif of stone cottages with shutters and tile roofs typical of rural France (Pissarro/Sisley school).
